variants.champion_v1: The production predictor probability, mirrored without trading impact.
variants.base_rate: Direction-conditional empirical base rate only: long=0.466, short=0.534.
variants.shrink75_to_base: Base rate plus 25% of the champion deviation; a 75% shrink toward base.

primary_metric: paired mean Brier score on conclusive outcomes
secondary_metrics: correlation between p_correct and realized directional excess
promotion_rule: No promotion before both minimums. A challenger must improve paired mean Brier by at least 0.01 and the entry-date block-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for challenger-minus-champion must be below 0. Secondary metrics must not materially regress.
notes: Preregistered after the 2026-07-31 selection-funnel backfill found negative p_correct/excess correlation. Outcomes before start_at are development evidence only.
